            objecttype = <object_status>-objecttype
            tablename  = enq_table-tabname

            bcset_id       = <object_status>-bcset
            objectname     = <object_status>-objectname
            objecttype     = <object_status>-objecttype
          changing
            rc_activ_old   = rc_activ
            bcsets_parents = bcsets_parents
            objects_stati  = objects_stati.

                       and   objecttype = enq_object-objecttype.

                        and   objtype = enq_object-objecttype.

      exporting

    delete enq_tables.
